preconditions.description: Input consists of two integers n (total problems) and k (days), each within the specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and len(stdout.split()) == k + 1 and all(int(a) > 0 for a in stdout.split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output is 'NO'. Otherwise, output is 'YES' followed by a sequence of k positive integers representing problems per day.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and sum(int(a) for a in stdout.split()[1:]) == int(n)
postconditions.description: The sum of the sequence equals the total number of problems n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(int(stdout.split()[i+1]) > int(stdout.split()[i]) and int(stdout.split()[i+1]) <= 2 * int(stdout.split()[i]) for i in range(k-1))
postconditions.description: For each day i, the next day's problems satisfy a_{i+1} > a_i and a_{i+1} <= 2*a_i.
